en.name: jakegu1/vetagent
en.description: Pre-trade token check for AI agents that asks whether you could still sell. Sell simulation and buy/sell tax (Ethereum, BSC, Base), mint/freeze authority and holder concentration (Solana), liquidity depth, pair age and same-ticker impersonation, returned as one `low`/`medium`/`high`/`unknown` verdict with the signals behind it. Fail-closed: when a critical check cannot run it answers `unknown`, never low, and `low` means the exit was open when checked, not that nobody can close it. Publishes its measured error rates with the benchmark harness that reproduces them. Read-only: executes no trades, gives no investment advice. Remote Streamable HTTP endpoint `https://vetagent.dev/mcp` (no auth), plus plain HTTP `POST https://vetagent.dev/assess`. Official MCP Registry id `dev.vetagent/vetagent`. Free, no signup. MIT.
